headline: 綠洲合唱團宣布重返演唱會
context: 英國樂團 Oasis 宣布 2027 年展開巡演，其中包含闊別 30 年、重返英國肯尼沃斯（Knebworth）的場次——1996 年他們曾在那裡連續兩晚，吸引 25 萬人到場，被視為生涯高峰。回顧當年，《衛報》其實沒有真正評論這兩場演出，反而把版面留給了暖場團 The Charlatans。

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: After 2025’s wildly lucrative reunion, the Gallagher brothers will tour the UK, Ireland and US, and revisit the Hertfordshire site of their greatest live triumph • From the archive: How did the Guardian cover Oasis at Knebworth 1996? Well … we didn’t Oasis have finally confirmed new tour dates for 2027, including their long-rumoured return to Knebworth for a run of shows 30 years after they played a historic two nights at the Hertfordshire venue in 1996. “Start the celebrations!”, the band said in a statement. “After a period of reflection, The Most Damaging Pop Cultural Force in Recent British History” – a quote from a Guardian opinion piece about the band – “has declared itself fit for purpose and will once again return to lift the spirits of the people. Come witness the fitness. It shall be a sight to behold.” Continue reading...
sources.title: Oasis announce 2027 tour, including return to Knebworth 30 years after historic concerts

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: Noel Gallagher told fans ‘this is history’ but the paper opted to review support act the Charlatans instead, as that band returned from tragedy • News: Oasis announce 2027 tour, including return to Knebworth 30 years after historic concerts Over two days in August 1996, Oasis played to 250,000 people at Knebworth House in Hertfordshire . Riding high on two bestselling albums, the concerts were seen as the crowning moment in their career. The Guardian covered the weekend but Caroline Sullivan’s review concentrated on the Charlatans, one of the support acts. There was a picture of the Knebworth crowds on page 7, but the main review that day was of folk-rock band Fairport Convention’s Cropredy festival . There was also a review of the “anti-Oasis ” Divine Comedy . Continue reading...
sources.title: How did the Guardian cover Oasis at Knebworth 1996? Well … we didn’t

thread_text:
英國樂團 Oasis 宣布 2027 年展開巡演，其中包含闊別 30 年、重返肯尼沃斯（Knebworth）的場次。1996 年他們曾在那裡連續兩晚演出，吸引 25 萬人到場，被視為生涯高峰。回顧當年，《衛報》其實沒有真正評論這兩場演出，版面反而留給了暖場團 The Charlatans。

本則整理自 The Guardian 於 2026 年 9 月 14 日發佈的報導。
threads_text:
英國樂團 Oasis 正式宣布 2027 年巡演計畫，將重返英國肯尼沃斯（Knebworth）——這裡是他們生涯最高峰的舞台，1996 年他們曾在此連續兩晚演出，吸引 25 萬人到場，這次是闊別 30 年後的回歸。樂團在聲明裡說「開始慶祝吧！」把自己形容為「近代英國流行文化最具破壞力的力量」。回顧《衛報》當年的報導，1996 年那兩場肯尼沃斯演唱會，其實沒有被真正評論過——當天的主打樂評，寫的是民謠搖滾樂團 Fairport Convention 的克羅普雷迪音樂節，Oasis 的版面反而留給了暖場團 The Charlatans，當天的樂評版面還提到了一場「反 Oasis」的 Divine Comedy 演出。

本則整理自 The Guardian 於 2026 年 9 月 14 日發佈的報導，讓圖書館員翻譯給你聽。
voice_text: 英國樂團 Oasis 宣布 2027 年展開巡演，其中包含重返英國肯尼沃斯（Knebworth）的場次，闊別整整三十年。一九九六年，他們曾在那裡連續兩晚演出，吸引二十五萬人到場，被視為生涯最高峰。回頭看當年的紀錄，其實那兩場演唱會沒有被真正好好評論過，版面反而留給了暖場的樂團。
